borrowed_system.definition: A rule system the audience already knows from another domain, imported whole as the story's scaffolding.

broken_rule.definition: One expected rule of the borrowed system or genre is deliberately violated, and the story runs on that violation.

unserved_appetite.definition: A desire the audience has that existing works in the space rarely satisfy.

visible_progress_counter.definition: Advancement is measured on a scale the audience can read and track.

cost_of_advancement.definition: Gaining power or progress takes something the agent values.

access_gate.definition: The condition that decides who can obtain power or enter the arena.

core_tension.definition: The central opposition whose logic keeps generating conflict.

information_asymmetry.definition: A gap in what the audience and characters know, or between characters, that drives choices.

bond_as_power.definition: A relationship itself is the source or multiplier of power.
